verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator. Its Ledger serves local views and explicitly says it does so "without exposing a mutation API", and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. The CLI covers its operations, but it is a different interface rather than a documented programmatic API matching the UI, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
